hook.en: Mitochondria and chloroplasts carry their own DNA and their own ribosomes, almost like small bacteria living inside our cells.
hook.kn: ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ ಮತ್ತು ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ DNA ಮತ್ತು ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವಕೋಶದೊಳಗೆ ವಾಸಿಸುವ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳಂತೆ.

objectives.en: Describe the structure of a mitochondrion.
Classify plastids and describe the chloroplast.

narration.en: Mitochondria and chloroplasts carry their own DNA and their own ribosomes, almost like small bacteria living inside our cells.
narration.kn: ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ ಮತ್ತು ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ DNA ಮತ್ತು ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವಕೋಶದೊಳಗೆ ವಾಸಿಸುವ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳಂತೆ.

body.en: Mitochondria are sausage-shaped or cylindrical, 0.2–1.0 μm wide (average 0.5 μm) and 1.0–4.1 μm long. Each has a double membrane: the outer membrane forms the boundary, and the inner membrane folds into cristae that increase the surface area. The matrix inside has a single circular DNA molecule, a few RNA molecules, 70S ribosomes and the components for protein synthesis. They are the sites of aerobic respiration, produce energy as ATP (the power houses of the cell) and divide by fission.

points.en: Two compartments: the outer compartment and the inner matrix.
Cristae: infoldings of the inner membrane.

Each has a double membrane: the outer membrane forms the boundary, and the inner membrane folds into cristae that increase the surface area. The matrix inside has a single circular DNA molecule, a few RNA molecules, 70S ribosomes and the components for protein synthesis. They are the sites of aerobic respiration, produce energy as ATP (the power houses of the cell) and divide by fission.
narration.kn: ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಪೊರೆಗಳಿವೆ; ಒಳಪೊರೆ ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಟೆಗಳಾಗಿ ಮಡಚಿದೆ. ಮಾತೃಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರದ DNA ಮತ್ತು 70S ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ. ಇವು ಜೀವಕೋಶದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು.

body.en: Plastids occur in all plant cells and in euglenoids. Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and carotenoids; chromoplasts contain fat-soluble carotenoids (yellow, orange, red); leucoplasts are colourless stores: amyloplasts store starch (potato), elaioplasts store oils and fats, and aleuroplasts store proteins. A chloroplast is double-membraned and 5–10 μm long, 2–4 μm wide; Chlamydomonas has one per cell, while a mesophyll cell has 20–40. Thylakoids are stacked into grana, joined by stroma lamellae; the stroma has enzymes for carbohydrate and protein synthesis, circular DNA and 70S ribosomes. Ribosomes were first seen by George Palade (1953); eukaryotic cytoplasmic ribosomes are 80S (60S + 40S). S, the Svedberg unit, is a sedimentation coefficient that reflects density and size.

points.en: Amyloplast – starch; elaioplast – oils; aleuroplast – proteins.
Ribosomes are made of RNA and proteins and have no membrane.

narration.kn: ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಡ್‌ಗಳು ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕ, ವರ್ಣಲವಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶ್ವೇತಲವಕ ಎಂದು ಮೂರು ವಿಧ. ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರ್ಯಾನಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಮಾ ಇವೆ. ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟಿಕ್ ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್ 80S, ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟಿಕ್ 70S.

problem.en: A cell organelle is double-membraned, contains its own circular DNA and 70S ribosomes, and has stacks of flattened sacs in a matrix. Identify it and name the stacks and the matrix.

steps.en: Double membrane + own DNA + 70S ribosomes: mitochondrion or chloroplast.
Stacks of flattened membranous sacs are thylakoids arranged in grana, found only in chloroplasts.
The matrix of a chloroplast is called the stroma.

points.en: Mitochondria: double membrane, cristae, matrix with circular DNA and 70S ribosomes.
points.kn: ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ: ಎರಡು ಪೊರೆ, ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಟೆ, DNA ಮತ್ತು 70S ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್.

points.en: Chloroplast: grana of thylakoids in the stroma.
Ribosomes: 80S in eukaryotes, 70S in prokaryotes and organelles.

homework.en: Draw labelled diagrams of a mitochondrion and a chloroplast.

narration.en: Recap. Mitochondria: double membrane, cristae, matrix with circular DNA and 70S ribosomes. Plastids: chloroplasts, chromoplasts and leucoplasts. Chloroplast: grana of thylakoids in the stroma. Ribosomes: 80S in eukaryotes, 70S in prokaryotes and organelles.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ: ಎರಡು ಪೊರೆ, ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಟೆ, DNA ಮತ್ತು 70S ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್. ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಡ್‌ಗಳು: ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕ, ವರ್ಣಲವಕ, ಶ್ವೇತಲವಕ. ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕ: ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಮಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಥೈಲಕಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳ ಗ್ರ್ಯಾನಾ. ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್: ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ 80S, ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ 70S.
